request: Analyze GSE214542 for PMID 36720890 (Irisin exhibits neuroprotection by preventing mitochondrial damage in Parkinson's disease.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq of mouse nigral/midbrain tissue (S4.16.p1); GEO series holds two experiments: irisin pre-treatment (Control/MPTP/Irisin+MPTP, n=3 each) and irisin delayed treatment (Control/Irisin/MPTP/MPTP+Irisin, n=3 each)
final.primary_estimand: Effect of exogenous recombinant irisin (i.p. 200 ug/kg/d, 5 days) on the midbrain transcriptome of MPTP-treated mice (S2.5.p1, FIG4). Exercise appears only in the human cohort (S2.1.p1: 23 PD patients, 12-week exercise, serum irisin ELISA, no transcriptomics). No sequenced sample received exercise.
final.sample_inclusion: male C57BL/6 mice, 6 weeks (GEO characteristics); n=3 per group
planned_contrasts: Irisin+MPTP vs MPTP (pre-treatment), GSEA only (S2.5.p1, Supplementary Fig. 3a-b, Fig. 4a); paper reports no DEG count
MPTP+Irisin vs MPTP (delayed treatment), GSEA only (S2.5.p1, Supplementary Fig. 3c-d, Fig. 4b); paper reports no DEG count
final.paper_method: featureCounts read counts; downstream analysis in R (S4.16.p1), DE method not named; GEO data_processing: StringTie/edgeR expression, DE |log2FC| >= 1 and p < 0.05

paper_threshold.source_locator: GEO data_processing (not in the article text); article reports GSEA only

final.paper_results: GSEA pathways (NAD(P)H oxidoreductase activity, focal adhesion, PI3K-Akt, MAPK); no DEG counts or gene lists in the article

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: The paper studies irisin as an exercise-induced myokine. Exercise is applied only to human PD patients (S2.1.p1, Table 1) whose readout is serum irisin and clinical scores. The RNA-seq (S2.5.p1, S4.16.p1, DA.p1 -> GSE214542) compares MPTP mice with and without injected recombinant irisin, so its estimand is a pharmacological irisin effect, not an exercise effect.

matrix.reasoning: The deposited file mixes FPKM.* and count.* columns; the count.* columns are 100% integer with library sizes 66-76M. Paper S4.16.p1 states featureCounts read counts as input; GEO data_processing says StringTie. Integer count columns used; FPKM columns not used.

design.stop_reason: No exercise contrast: every sequenced sample is a sedentary mouse given vehicle, MPTP and/or injected recombinant irisin (GEO treatment field; S2.5.p1). Exercise exists only in the human serum cohort (S2.1.p1), which has no transcriptome. Irisin injection is not exercise; an irisin-vs-vehicle contrast would answer a different (pharmacological) estimand.
